## In the page

- **"GET Users"**: button. In `NetworkApiElements` as `GET_USERS_BUTTON`: `click().getUsers()`.
- **"GET User 1"**: button. In `NetworkApiElements` as `GET_USER_1_BUTTON`: `click().getUser1()`.
- **"GET Missing User"**: button. In `NetworkApiElements` as `GET_MISSING_USER_BUTTON`: `click().getMissingUser()`.
- **"GET Products — 2s Delay"**: button. In `NetworkApiElements` as `GET_PRODUCTS_2S_DELAY_BUTTON`: `click().getProducts2sDelay()`.
- **"HTTP 400"**: button. In `NetworkApiElements` as `HTTP_400_BUTTON`: `click().http400()`.
- **"HTTP 404"**: button. In `NetworkApiElements` as `HTTP_404_BUTTON`: `click().http404()`.
- **"HTTP 500"**: button. In `NetworkApiElements` as `HTTP_500_BUTTON`: `click().http500()`.
- **"Reset API data"**: button. In `NetworkApiElements` as `RESET_API_DATA_BUTTON`: `click().resetApiData()`.

## "Create User" form (in the page)

- **"First name"**: text field. In `NetworkApiElements` as `FIRST_NAME_INPUT`: `enter().firstName(...)`.
- **"Last name"**: text field. In `NetworkApiElements` as `LAST_NAME_INPUT`: `enter().lastName(...)`.
- **"Role"**: dropdown. In `NetworkApiElements` as `ROLE_SELECT`: `enter().role(option)`.
- **"Create user"**: button. In `NetworkApiElements` as `CREATE_USER_BUTTON`: `click().createUser()`.
